commands.rootCmdShort: An app that helps with fighting akrasia
commands.rootCmdLong:
Akrasia is a word in greek that means "Incontinence", which means a lack of self-control.
This app is constructed to simply help to fight akrasía rapidly in the terminal, by adding things to do
and to keep track of these things for you.

Run `akrasia` alone to open the interactive interface, or `akrasia help` to list every command.
commands.addShort: create a new task with optional description, priority, and expiration date
commands.addExample:
akrasia add "Morning run" --daily --priority high --date 31,12
akrasia add "Morning run" "Do 5km at the park" --priority medium
akrasia add --name "Morning run" --daily --priority low
akrasia add "Bake cake" --parent "Party"
commands.getAllShort: returns all the todos saved in storage
commands.todayShort: show a daily focus dashboard (overdue, due today, daily pending, expiring soon)
commands.focusShort: show top 1-3 priority items to focus on right now
commands.getTodoByNameShort: search for a task by name (case-insensitive, fuzzy match)
commands.updateStatusShort: mark a task as completed and record it in history with optional notes (run it again the same day to replace the notes)
commands.checkExpiredShort: show tasks that have passed their expiration date
commands.checkExpiringShort: check todos that are expiring in 5 days
commands.getTodoCurrentStreakShort: get the current streak of provided todo
commands.getTodoStreakHistoryShort: get the streak history of provided todo
commands.backfillHistoryShort: backfill missing daily task history entries
commands.debugShort: inspect a task's stored history and streak math (diagnostics)
commands.dumpShort: store a dump entry, list them, delete one or turn one into a task
commands.configShort: manage settings (theme, language, TUI keymap, backups, reminders)
commands.progressShort: show today's progress (tasks done out of today's tasks)
commands.editShort: change the name, description, priority, daily mode or date of a task
commands.editExample:
akrasia edit "Morning run" --name "Morning walk"
akrasia edit stendhal --priority low --date 30,11
akrasia edit "Read" --daily=false --desc ""
commands.notesShort: show the notes written each day a task was completed
commands.notesExample:
akrasia notes "Estudar Rust"
akrasia notes rust --limit 7
commands.dumpExample:
akrasia dump "learn about sql indexes"
akrasia dump                      # numbered list
akrasia dump --delete 2
akrasia dump --to-task 1 --priority high --date 30,11
commands.backupShort: copy the database to the backup folder now
commands.backupListShort: list this machine's backups, newest first
commands.restoreShort: replace the database with a backup (the current one is saved first)
commands.restoreExample:
akrasia restore latest
akrasia restore latest --profile work-pc
akrasia restore ~/Dropbox/akrasia/akrasia-home-2026-10-19_093000.db --yes
commands.configBackupShort: set the backup folder, how many copies to keep and the profile name
commands.configBackupExample:
akrasia config backup dir ~/Dropbox/akrasia
akrasia config backup keep 30
akrasia config backup profile work-pc
akrasia config backup show
akrasia config backup off
commands.notifyShort: send the Discord reminders that are due (run from cron by `config notify install`)
commands.configNotifyShort: set up reminders in a Discord channel
commands.configNotifyExample:
akrasia config notify discord https://discord.com/api/webhooks/…
akrasia config notify mention 123456789012345678
akrasia config notify days 3
akrasia config notify times 10:00,19:00
akrasia config notify daily-at 19:00
akrasia config notify test
akrasia config notify install
commands.serveShort: run the web interface for your phone, plus the daily backup and the reminders
commands.serveTokenShort: show the token a device enters once (--new replaces it)
commands.serveInstallShort: run serve as a systemd user service that starts with the computer
commands.serveUninstallShort: stop and remove the systemd service

flags.addDate: due date: dd, dd,mm or dd,mm,yyyy (default: tomorrow)
flags.updateStatusToConcludedNotes: notes for today; completing the task again the same day replaces them
flags.deleteConcludedDeleteYes: confirm destructive deletion of concluded tasks
flags.backfillHistoryDays: number of days back to backfill
flags.backfillHistoryName: specific task name to backfill (optional, fills all daily tasks if not set)
flags.todayLimit: limit items per section (0 = no limit)
flags.editDaily: make the task daily (true) or one-off (false)
flags.editDate: new due date: dd, dd,mm or dd,mm,yyyy
flags.notesLimit: how many days to show (0 = all)
flags.dumpDelete: delete the dump entry with this number
flags.dumpToTask: turn the dump entry with this number into a task (with --priority, --daily, --date)
flags.dumpPriority: priority of the task created with --to-task
flags.dumpDaily: make the task created with --to-task daily
flags.dumpDate: due date of the task created with --to-task: dd, dd,mm or dd,mm,yyyy
flags.backupProfile: use another machine's backups (default: this machine's profile)
flags.addParent: make it a subtask of this task (follows its daily mode; due with it unless --date is given)
flags.updateStatusToConcludedYes: complete a task with pending subtasks (and them) without asking
flags.serveAddr: address to listen on (default: 127.0.0.1:8080, or "addr" in serve.json)
flags.serveTokenNew: replace the token; every device has to enter the new one

error.taskName: task name is required (use positional argument or --name flag)
error.destructiveAction: destructive action blocked: use --yes to confirm
error.dateBeforeNow: %s is in the past; use today or a later date
error.dateNotEnoughArguments: a date is dd, dd,mm or dd,mm,yyyy
error.invalidMonthNumber: month number is not between 1 and 12
error.nothingToEdit: nothing to change: pass at least one of --name, --desc, --priority, --daily or --date
error.dumpFlags: use only one of --delete and --to-task, without a new entry
error.backupOff: no backup folder set: run `akrasia config backup dir <path>`
error.backupKeep: invalid number of copies: %q (use a number from 1 up)
error.backupAction: unknown option: %q (use show, off, dir, keep or profile)
error.notifyOff: no Discord webhook set: run `akrasia config notify discord <url>`
error.notifyWebhook: not a Discord webhook URL (channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → Copy Webhook URL)
error.notifyMention: invalid user ID: %q (a number; turn on Developer Mode, then right click your name → Copy User ID), or none
error.notifyDailyAt: %s is not one of the reminder times %v; add it with `config notify times` first
error.notifyAction: unknown option: %q (use show, test, install, uninstall, off, discord, mention, days, times or daily-at)
error.noCrontab: crontab not found: install cron (cronie on Arch) or run `akrasia notify` from another scheduler
error.serveRunning: akrasia serve is already running on this database (systemctl --user status akrasia)
error.restoreWhileServing: akrasia serve is using the database: stop it first (systemctl --user stop akrasia), restore, then start it again
error.windowsUnsupported: `akrasia %s` needs %s, which Windows doesn't have. Run akrasia inside WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux), where it works, or use the Windows Task Scheduler to run `akrasia serve` or `akrasia notify`.

quotes.quote1: "We suffer more often in imagination than in reality. And yet, we put off what matters to the calm, indefinite future, as if time were ours to command." - Seneca, Moral Letters to Lucilius (Letter 13).
quotes.quote2: "The present is the only time that is truly ours. To allow the mind to wander in past regret or future anxiety is the greatest theft of the self." - Marcus Aurelius, Meditations (Adapted from Book 3, 10; Book 8, 36).
quotes.quote3: "One must not think that a task is easy simply because it is not urgent. It is the non-urgent tasks that most often define the quality of a life." - Inspired by Epictetus's doctrine of prohairesis (moral character).
quotes.quote4: "The soul is dyed by the color of its thoughts. Guard, therefore, your thinking, for it becomes your action. Guard your action, for it becomes your habit." - Marcus Aurelius, Meditations (Book 5, 16).
quotes.quote5: "We must keep constant guard over our perceptions, for they are the gatekeepers of the mind." - Epictetus, Discourses (Book 4, 12).
quotes.quote6: "The mind distracted is the mind diminished. It is not a single flame but scattered embers, giving neither light nor heat." - Inspired by Plutarch's "On the Control of Anger" and the Stoic doctrine of unity of mind.
quotes.quote7: "To postpone is to choose. When you defer a good action, you have actively chosen the worse state of your soul." - Inspired by Socrates in Plato's Gorgias.
quotes.quote8: "The cause of human inaction is not that the task is large, but that the will is small. Begin, and the mind will be heated; continue, and the task will be completed." - Adapted from Democritus (Fragment 84) and the Stoic principle of "begin."
quotes.quote9: "No one errs willingly; the failure to act rightly is a failure of knowledge, not of will." - Socrates, in Plato's Protagoras
quotes.quote10: "Self-control (enkrateia) is the foundation of virtue, and the first step is to master your pleasures and appetites." - Aristotle, Nicomachean Ethics
quotes.quote11: "I see and approve the better course, but I follow the worse." - Ovid, Metamorphoses
quotes.quote12: "The wise man is commanded by reason, the fool by passion, and the madman by whim." - Zeno of Citium
quotes.quote13: "How long will you wait before you demand the best for yourself?" - Epictetus, Discourses
